candidates.name: Kobra Pistol
candidates.reviewNote: DA requires two Saving Rolls, supporting the current Wiki/Army number despite the PDF one-roll cell; Anti-materiel remains a separate source conflict.

officialUpdate.claim: Kobra Pistol ammunition changes to Shock (BS) and DA (CC); no explicit Anti-materiel or Saving Roll count statement.

semanticReview.finding: N5.3 Kobra Pistol CC Mode uses DA (p.68/182), and the DA rule (p.64) requires two Saving Rolls per hit. The N5.3 chart prints one; current Army and Wiki print two. Army/Wiki also list Anti-materiel, which is not shown for Kobra CC in the PDF and is not implied by DA.
semanticReview.remaining: Treat two effective Saving Rolls as rules-supported; independently review whether Anti-materiel applies and retain the PDF one-roll cell as source-discrepancy evidence.
